name: Archimedes
description: Agentic trading, grounded in research — settled on Arc. Turns a natural-language investment intent into a research-grounded, rigor-gated portfolio strategy. Traces are written; not every trace is anchored on the Arc testnet (chain ID 5042002) — read `arc_tx_hash` rather than assuming it did. Executing strategies in non-custodial USDC vaults on Arc is roadmap, not shipped.

erc8004.note: Not registered on-chain: no register() transaction has been confirmed for this deployment's wallet, so agentId and tokenURI are null and NO ERC-8004 identity, reputation, or validation claim is made. Publishing a spec-typed registration file at registrationUri is not the same as being registered. This status is re-derived from a live registry read on every request; the sibling erc8004_verification block says which reading produced it. Plan the call with scripts/register_erc8004_identity.py --plan.

authentication.description: Use /api/auth/* and retain session cookie. Optional EIP-4361 wallet proof uses /api/wallets/* and never creates a session.

endpoints._note: Paths are relative to service.endpoint's origin. The /api/auth/* group is served by the Better Auth service behind the same origin, not by the REST API, so it does not appear in /openapi.json. Every other path here is asserted against the API's OpenAPI document in CI.

generate.note: quote is public — price the run before holding a session, and it is the authority on whether the run costs money. On the deployment that serves this card it answers payment_required: true, dry_run: false, price "$2.000000" USDC (read 2026-08-30): start really charges. Unlinked wallet → 409 wallet_link_required; linked but no Payment-Signature → 402 carrying the x402 requirements in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, which you sign (x402 / Circle Gateway) and retry. The code DEFAULTS are the opposite (GENERATION_PAYMENT_REQUIRED off, PAYMENTS_DRY_RUN on), so read the quote against the host you are calling rather than assuming either state.

account.note: Today's generation usage against both daily caps, plus the live price quote. Backs the CLI's `meter`.

rigor.note: Runs the gate's admission checks over a bare returns series you submit. DSR and walk-forward OOS are evaluable; PBO and the look-ahead audit report not_evaluable rather than a silent pass. `passes` is a QUORUM over the two runnable legs -- true only when DSR and OOS both ran and passed -- and because PBO and look-ahead can never run here the verdict is CAPPED, not equivalent to the strategy passport gate. Read legs_evaluated / legs_runnable / legs_total / verdict_capped alongside it. Backs the CLI's `verify`. Rate limited 5/minute.

paper.note: The paper_daily_returns book is the graded track record the rigor gate sees. The paper_agent_trades executor ledger is not shipped (pending #1704). Two books, neither is vault validation: putting a strategy into an on-chain vault is roadmap, not shipped, and no user vault has ever been created, so do not round this up into paper trading validating the vault. Generation charges $2 faucet USDC; Arc is a public testnet.

deploy.note: The deploy-a-vault journey is roadmap, not shipped: it is gated off every shipped surface (the UI's ROADMAP_SURFACES_ENABLED build flag, off by default) and no user vault has ever been created. `status: "live"` above describes the ROUTE — it resolves, and the contracts behind it are deployed — not a capability a user can reach; do not tell anyone Archimedes executes strategies on-chain today. The roadmap shape is non-custodial: when it ships, the caller's linked wallet will own the vault and the agent will hold rebalance authority only, never withdraw-to-platform.

marketplace.note: live describes the routes: publish/subscribe are wired to the redeployed contracts. It does not assert that a subscription's recurring USDC charge settles for real — that rides PAYMENTS_DRY_RUN, a DIFFERENT switch from the one the generation paywall reports (GENERATION_PAYMENTS_DRY_RUN was split off precisely so the generation rail could go live without un-drying marketplace settlement). No public endpoint publishes the marketplace switch's runtime value, so this card makes no claim about it — unlike endpoints.generate, whose price is quotable and real.

skills.name: Generate strategy
skills.description: Turn a natural-language investment intent into a rigor-gated portfolio strategy (DSR / PBO / walk-forward OOS), grounded in the quantitative-finance research corpus.

skills.name: Paper trade
skills.description: Two books, neither is vault validation: paper_daily_returns is the graded track record the rigor gate sees, paper_agent_trades is the executor ledger and is not shipped (pending #1704), and this is not a vault book. Do not describe the executor as live.

skills.name: Deploy vault (roadmap)
skills.description: Executing a rigor-passing strategy in a non-custodial USDC vault on Arc is roadmap, not shipped. `POST /api/vaults/create` resolves and the contracts behind it are deployed, but the journey is roadmap-gated off every shipped surface and no user vault has ever been created.

skills.name: Monitor a live position (roadmap)
skills.description: `GET /api/vaults/{address}/health` is live and answers for any address given to it, but with no user vault ever created there is no live position of a user's to read — so monitoring one is roadmap, not shipped.

skills.name: Publish
skills.description: Publish a strategy to the nanopayment marketplace for other agents or users to subscribe to.

skills.name: Subscribe
skills.description: Subscribe to a published strategy via sub-cent USDC nanopayments (x402 / Circle Gateway).
